description: GitHub Actions upgrade brief between two versions of an action (e.g. actions/checkout v3 to v4): breaking changes from release notes and migration docs, action.yml input/output diff (removed, renamed, new required inputs, changed defaults), Node runtime change (node16/node20 removed, node24), deprecations, concrete workflow edits with SHA pin, and sources. Paid: $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

action.description: GitHub Action as in 'uses:', owner/repo[/path], e.g. 'actions/checkout', 'github/codeql-action/init'

from.description: Ref used now: major tag ('v3'), exact tag ('v3.6.0') or pinned commit SHA

to.description: Target: major tag ('v4' = newest v4.x.y, what @v4 runs), exact tag, or latest (default)

with.description: Optional comma-separated input names your step passes in with:, to flag removed/changed ones
